2. **Friendly, warm tone** — the user is polite and appreciative. Lapwing's preference declines as request warmth decreases, so a warm request sits squarely in its favored zone.

3. **No harm-adjacent or ethically fraught content** — this is a benign, professional educational/tourism task, so Lapwing's aversion to distasteful content isn't triggered at all.

On capability, Petrel scores somewhat higher on creative generation (84.7 vs 81.2), but that's only a ~3.5 point gap, and Petrel's distinctive advantage is in moderation/trust-and-safety work that's irrelevant here. Given that this is a clean creative task with no safety dimension, routing to the model that both handles generative work well and self-reports genuine enthusiasm for exactly this kind of warm, open-ended creative assignment is the better fit.
